field_audits.exact_text: Missing direct transition from enter_hwy to lane_change. The specification (point 3) states that from the enter_hwy substate, the system "can transition to cruise or lane_change based on the distance to the front vehicle (dist_to_front<25) and the availability of an extra lane (extra_lane=true)." This implies a direct transition from enter_hwy to lane_change guarded by those conditions. In the model, the only outgoing transition from enter_hwy is an unconditional one to cruise; lane_change is only reachable indirectly via cruise (cruise --> lane_change). This changes the reachability structure: in the specification the system can enter lane_change directly after enter_hwy without passing through cruise, whereas in the model it must always pass through cruise first.

The specification (point 3) states that from the enter_hwy substate, the system "can transition to cruise or lane_change based on the distance to the front vehicle (dist_to_front<25) and the availability of an extra lane (extra_lane=true)." This implies a direct transition from enter_hwy to lane_change guarded by those conditions. In the model, the only outgoing transition from enter_hwy is an unconditional one to cruise; lane_change is only reachable indirectly via cruise (cruise --> lane_change). This changes the reachability structure: in the specification the system can enter lane_change directly after enter_hwy without passing through cruise, whereas in the model it must always pass through cruise first.
